_about: The reviewed metadata of every catalog pack, by pack id (= its folder name). scripts/library/prepare.js writes each into its folder's pack.json. Tags: category ids first (they decide the Home categories), then what the pack shows and is for; every tag has search words in library/_tags.json.
source: Claude Design: the Stickers page manifest (packs.json: theme, lang, adult), Pack Ideas (moods, characters, sticker lines) and the WhatsApp export of 2026-09-30 (120 folders; animated variants are packs of their own).
